claims.note: SP 800-38D section 7.2, Algorithm 5: output is 'plaintext P or indication of inauthenticity FAIL'; step 8 returns P only if T = T', else FAIL. The SP permits but does not require tag-first order ('the verification of the tag may precede the computation of the plaintext'). The observable rule, no plaintext on tag failure, holds.
